caption: The perspective of the scene has shifted to the right. A small purple figurine has been added to the left of the pink hair dryer. A white remote control has been added to the right of the hair dryer.
The polar bear on the right side of the frame, which was previously facing left with its head slightly lowered and eyes closed, is now looking to the left with its head slightly raised.

The squirrel on the left side of the image has disappeared. A new black bird has appeared in the back left corner of the image, standing on the tree stump and looking toward the right side of the image. The peanut that was originally in the squirrel's mouth has been placed on the tree stump in the lower left corner of the image. The peanuts on the tree stump in the lower left corner have been moved to the tree stump in the upper right corner.
The perspective of the image shifts to the right.
The scene has become brighter. The red car that was previously visible in the distance on the right side of the frame is no longer present. A yellow snowplow has appeared on the road in the distance.
The three people in the middle of the formation change from having their arms crossed in front of their chests to turning to face away from the camera, with their backs to the screen.

The green and white notebook on the blue stand in the middle of the screen has been replaced with a light blue notebook. The black mouse on the left side of the keyboard has moved to the right side of the keyboard, and a camera with a lens has appeared in its original position.
The polar bear on the right side of the frame has its mouth open, revealing its tongue. The polar bear in the middle has lowered its head and is resting against the mother polar bear's back.

A person wearing a white top and blue pants has appeared near the stove on the right side of the kitchen, facing away from the camera towards the stove. The stainless steel kettle on the black countertop above the oven has disappeared. A bright blue "kitchen" sign has appeared in front of the round table in the center of the scene.

The blue and white striped beach chair, originally facing the waterfall, has turned to face the tree on the right side of the scene. The green picnic mat in front of the blue and white beach chair has been replaced by a red and white checkered picnic blanket with the word "Picnic" written on it.

The scene has become darker. A man in a black vest and blue pants appears on the right side of the road, with his back to the road, facing the blue table on the right side of the road, and his left hand in his pocket.The person wearing a white hat and yellow jacket who appeared near the center of the scene, standing next to the street light on the left side of the road and facing the building on the left, is no longer visible.
The scene has become more illuminated. The blackboard located behind the teacher's podium in the center of the classroom has decreased in size.
The blackboard located behind the teacher's podium has shifted to the right. The first row of school desks on the right side has been replaced by a black rectangular table.

The chair on the front left side of the wooden table has disappeared. The chair on the back right side of the wooden table has also disappeared. The transparent glass water pitcher on the wooden table has been replaced by a white and transparent glass cup. The red kettle on the black countertop above the stove on the right side of the kitchen has changed to green. The yellow kettle on the black countertop above the oven on the right side of the kitchen has appeared. The brown clock hanging on the green wall at the back left of the scene has disappeared.

The scene has become more illuminated. A cylindrical trash can has been newly placed at the bottom of the stairs on the left side of the scene, positioned next to the stair railing and beneath a light strip.
